events.title: NOOSA JAZZ CLUB PRESENTS PARIS CAFE JAZZ
events.description: Enjoy an afternoon of live Paris Cafe Jazz presented by the Noosa Jazz Club at the historic Majestic Theatre, featuring traditional and gypsy jazz sounds for an intimate musical experience.

events.title: SILENT FILM - THE LOST WORLD - 1925 - SCHOOL HOLIDAY FEATURE
events.description: Experience a classic silent film screening of "The Lost World" (1925) at the Majestic Theatre, a family-friendly school holiday feature offering a unique cinematic and historical atmosphere.

events.title: Yoga in the Garden
events.location: Sculpture Garden, Maroochy Regional Bushland Botanic Garden, Tanawha
events.description: Join a refreshing outdoor yoga session in the tranquil Sculpture Garden of the Maroochy Bushland Botanic Garden, suitable for all levels as part of the Healthy Sunshine Coast program.

events.title: Secret Garden (featuring Shannon Sol Carroll)
events.location: Maroochy Regional Bushland Botanic Garden, Tanawha
events.description: Enjoy an intimate musical performance by Shannon Sol Carroll in the beautiful outdoor setting of the Secret Garden at the Maroochy Bushland Botanic Garden.

events.title: CLARE COWLEY AND THE FLAMES
events.description: Experience a live musical performance by Clare Cowley and The Flames at the historic Majestic Theatre in Pomona, offering an afternoon of engaging music.

events.title: K-Pop Icons
events.description: Catch a performance celebrating K-Pop Icons at The Events Centre Caloundra, offering a dynamic and energetic live show for fans of Korean pop music.

events.title: How Soon is Now? (Bruce Reynolds Exhibition)
events.datetime: Ongoing Tue 24 - Sun 28 Jun (Gallery hours apply)
events.description: Explore "How Soon is Now?", the first national touring exhibition featuring thought-provoking works by acclaimed Brisbane artist Bruce Reynolds, focusing on contemporary art and ideas.

events.title: IMAGINATE: FIELDS OF FEELINGS WITH BONNIE HISLOP (Exhibition)
events.datetime: Ongoing Tue 24 - Sun 28 Jun (Gallery hours apply)
events.description: Discover "IMAGINATE: Fields of Feelings" by Bonnie Hislop, an engaging art exhibition at Noosa Regional Gallery exploring themes through vibrant and imaginative works.

events.title: IMAGINATE school holidays clay lab
events.datetime: Ongoing Tue 24 - Sun 28 Jun (check website for times)
